integrity: Proof and runnable finite test are provided. No independent scientific audit or external certification is asserted.
limitations: Exact unoversampled Fourier intensities, at most two nonzero complex coordinates, even cyclic length; no noise stability or higher-sparsity assertion. A plausible motivating 2021 article was only abstract-accessible, and historical originality remains best-knowledge.
title: Two almost-flat Fourier masks recover every complex two-sparse signal on even cycles
